1. 'Conical brass body...': Router marked is_present: false. Correct. The body is visually truncated and lacks the continuous conical geometry expected of a saxophone; it appears to merge into the player's vest.
2. 'Complex key mechanism...': Router marked is_present: false. Correct. The keys are represented as amorphous golden blobs without rods, pads, or springs. This is a structural hallucination masked by style.
3. 'Detachable mouthpiece...': Router marked is_present: false. Correct. The interface is melted.
4. 'Ligature...' & 'Neck cork...': Router marked is_testable: false. I agree these are effectively untestable due to the severe melting artifact at the mouthpiece which obscures these specific sub-components entirely.
5. 'Keys connected by rods...': Router marked is_present: false. Correct. No mechanical linkage is visible.
6. 'Lacquered brass...', 'Single-reed...', 'Silhouette...': Router marked is_present: true. These are acceptable as global features (color, general shape) are present, even if local details fail.
